# Purpose
The file contents represent a `.gitignore` configuration, which specifies intentionally untracked files to be ignored by Git version control. It includes directories and file patterns such as `__pycache__`, `*.pyc`, and `.venv`, which are typically generated during Python development and should not be included in the repository.
